text:
sam_support: Customer ACME reports embeddings throughput regression starting ~2026-03-15T03:00Z. Tokens/sec looks steady but vectors/sec dropped ~60%. They say requests succeed but tail latency and queue_depth spike on our side. GPU0 util at 98% on staging pool. 

olivia_sre: Can you paste the customer request example and a short repro? I can pull GPU metrics.

sam_support: Repro steps from customer (sanitized):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" 
 -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-v2","inputs":["short text"],"batching":{"max_batch_size":512,"auto":true},"dim":1536}'
```
They also batch up to 128 vectors per request.

michael_ml: 1536 dimension? rwd-embed-v2 expects 1024. If client is sending wrong dim metadata or our batching code chooses variant by dim, that could cause fallback to slower conversion path.

anna_prod: Customer claims they didn't change model, only upgraded their SDK yesterday. SDK release had an opt-in for send_dim metadata for async batching.

olivia_sre: Pulling logs now. Seeing a lot of WARNs: 
`kvcache: dim_mismatch detected, routing to dim-fallback; exec_path=slow_cpu_cast`
Queue depth for embedding service spiked from median 6->78 between 02:45-03:10Z.

srebot: Deploy 2026-03-14T22:10: feature/async-batching rolled to prod on pool-embed-us-east-1.

michael_ml: That matches. Fallback path does a CPU-side cast+repack when the incoming vector dim doesn't match the pinned model quant profile. CPU repack + small batches will blow up latency and raise GPU queue because tokens->vectors conversion is sequential there.

sam_support: Customer asked for suggested mitigations; they are seeing billing spikes too because of retries.

olivia_sre: Immediate steps: 1) throttle customer's max_batch_size to 8 via per-customer override (safe rollback) 2) add transient rule to route their requests to a compat variant that accepts 1536 if available 3) ask customer to revert SDK flag.

anna_prod: I applied a per-customer policy limiting max_batch_size to 8 at 03:35Z for acme-corp (policy id p-ACME-20260315). Observing vectors/sec recovering to ~85% of baseline.

sam_support: ACME confirmed slower but stable now. They reverted SDK flag.

michael_ml: Longer term actions: 
- add server-side validation rejecting mismatched dim with clearer 400 error instead of silently routing to fallback.
- metric: emit `embedding.dim_mismatch{customer}` and alert when rate > 0.5%
- add a fast-path conversion kernel for 1536->1024 that can run on GPU for limited bursts (engineering ticket).

olivia_sre: Filed infra ticket INF-2219 to add dim_mismatch metric and alerting. Filed runtime ticket RTE-1108 for immediate 400 validation.

sam_support: Customer happy with short-term fix, asked for a postmortem and suggested SDK safeguard.

anna_prod: Noted - will coordinate with SDK team to make default not to send `dim` unless explicit.

olivia_sre: Closing triage: root cause = SDK change sent `dim=1536` leading to routing to slow fallback path -> GPU queue surge -> vectors/sec regression. Remediation = per-customer throttle + SDK rollback + validation and instrumentation.

sam_support: Thanks all. I'll send ACME a short incident summary and the timeline. :thumbsup:
